note: Recast from the description of the new species by Ahmad (1965), original in English; the original records the soldier only; in Table 16 the mean pronotum length is printed as 1.47 mm, which is inconsistent with the holotype value of 0.49 and the range 0.44—0.50 and is presumably a misprint for 0.47, so the text gives only the holotype value and the range; figure 45 is not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale reddish brown; labrum concolorous with the head; mandibles deep reddish brown, paler at the base; antenna pale brown, uniform in colour; pronotum yellow with a brownish tinge. Head very sparsely hairy; labrum with long bristles along the two lateral margins and the apex; postmentum with a pair of short hairs at the apex and another pair of bristles slightly behind; pronotum with scattered short hairs, long bristles on the margins and the disc. Head slightly rectangular, sides slightly convex, gradually narrowing anteriorly; labrum longer than wide, apex narrowly rounded; mandibles stout, apical hook weak, left mandible with a lateral tooth slightly above the middle, right mandible with a tooth slightly below the level of the left tooth. Postmentum elongate and flat, about 2.5 times as long as wide, sides weakly concave at the middle and slightly convex above and below; antenna 15 segments, segment 2 longer than 3, segment 3 slightly shorter than 4. Pronotum about 2 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins slightly concave, lateral lobes broadly rounded. Measurements of 3 soldiers (holotype/range/mean): head length (to the lateral mandible base) 1.69/1.66—1.74/1.71 mm, head width (at the lateral mandible base) 0.91/0.88—0.93/0.90 mm, head width at the posterior end of the antennal carina 1.14/1.11—1.17/1.15 mm, maximum head width 1.22/1.20—1.30/1.24 mm, left mandible length 0.80/0.78—0.83/0.80 mm, distance from the left mandibular tooth to the apex 0.33/0.31—0.33/0.31 mm, postmentum length 1.09/1.09—1.14/1.11 mm, postmentum width 0.46 mm, pronotum length 0.49/0.44—0.50 mm, pronotum width 0.96/0.88—0.98/0.92 mm.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Closest to oblongatus, from which it differs in the slightly more pronounced anterior narrowing of the head, the shorter mandibles with a weaker apical hook, and the antenna with 15 segments (16 in oblongatus); compared with assmuthi the head is similar in size and shape, but the left mandibular tooth points forwards and lies further forward, and the mandibles are less stout than in that species.
